title: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles

reports.title: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles

summary: Anthropic reported that a weapons cell based in northern Yemen, designated GTG-87001, used Claude Code across three weapons programs to develop guidance, navigation, and control software. The actors reportedly test-fired a guided rocket that appeared to fail, then returned to Claude for failure analysis. Anthropic said it banned the accounts associated with the cell and shared threat intelligence with partners.
title_en: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles
